stories.name: Amazon delivery expansion
stories.blurb: Amazon is rapidly expanding and reshaping its delivery operations through partnerships, new logistics services, and lobbying, as it competes for control of the last mile.

stories.name: AI Financing Bubble
stories.blurb: Growing debt and financing strains behind the AI spending boom are raising fears of a market reckoning.

stories.name: Qualcomm-Amazon AI Chip Deal
stories.blurb: Qualcomm and Amazon announced a multi-generation partnership to develop custom AI data center chips, sending Qualcomm's stock sharply higher.

stories.name: Amazon stock rally
stories.blurb: Amazon shares are climbing as Morgan Stanley names the company a top pick and raises its price target ahead of Q3 earnings.

stories.name: Anthropic IPO
stories.blurb: Anthropic is preparing for a massive IPO, meeting investors, expanding its banking and credit lineup, and structuring founder control while launching new models and chip efforts.

stories.name: Amazon Q2 Earnings
stories.blurb: Amazon's stronger-than-expected Q2 earnings, driven by AWS growth and heavy investment, spark a stock rally and debate over whether shares remain a buy.

stories.name: Musk Delta Starlink feud
stories.blurb: Elon Musk is publicly feuding with Delta Air Lines and its CEO Ed Bastian over the airline's refusal to adopt Starlink Wi-Fi, while rivals United and American move to poach Delta customers.

stories.name: US AI national champions
stories.blurb: The Trump administration is reportedly designating major tech companies like Nvidia, Amazon, and Microsoft as AI 'national champions' while imposing new restrictions on Chinese data center and optical

stories.name: Amazon timekeeping change
stories.blurb: Amazon is changing how time works, affecting timekeeping globally.

past.name: AI data center selloff
past.blurb: Investors are selling off AI data center and hyperscaler stocks amid political uncertainty and doubts about the economics of massive infrastructure spending.

past.name: DoorDash Instacart acquisition
past.blurb: DoorDash is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire grocery delivery rival Instacart in a roughly $17 billion deal that would reshape the food delivery industry.

past.name: Big Tech Post-Election Rally
past.blurb: After the Democratic midterm sweep, major tech stocks like Amazon, Microsoft, and Apple surged as investors welcomed reduced political uncertainty.

past.name: AI spending selloff
past.blurb: Investors are dumping tech and cloud stocks after disappointing earnings from Amazon and Intel raised fears that heavy AI spending isn't paying off.

past.name: Big Tech AI cloud race
past.blurb: Tech giants like Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle are seeing soaring cloud growth driven by AI, prompting investors to debate which stock is the best buy.

past.name: Amazon AI spending surge
past.blurb: Amazon is dramatically ramping up capital spending on AI and cloud infrastructure, raising investor concerns about the scale of its cash burn even as it reports strong demand for AWS capacity.

past.name: Apple Smart Home Push
past.blurb: Apple is launching a new lineup of smart home devices and partnerships to challenge Amazon and Google in the smart home market.

past.name: Amazon Qualcomm AI deal
past.blurb: Amazon is partnering with Qualcomm on AI data-center chips, boosting Qualcomm's stock and validating its data-center pivot.

past.name: Meta Muse vs Amazon
past.blurb: Meta's new Muse AI shopping agent is integrating with Shopify, PayPal, and Shop Pay to challenge Amazon, which is moving to block the rival AI checkout tool from its platform, sparking market reaction

past.name: Amazon ecosystem expansion
past.blurb: A wave of companies are announcing new executive hires, certifications, and platform integrations aimed at serving brands and retailers selling across Amazon and other major marketplaces.

past.name: Big Tech Stock Picks
past.blurb: Investors and analysts are weighing whether to buy, sell, or hold major tech stocks like Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle amid AI-driven market shifts.

4.text: Amazon is fighting a New York City delivery-worker bill that it says could raise customer costs and affect over 5,000 contracted jobs, while the FAA probes a Michigan Prime Air drone crash. Amazon also expanded its car-shopping service abroad and may share a $309.5 million refund settlement.

18.text: AI credit and default-insurance costs are hitting records, with CoreWeave at distressed levels implying 68% five-year default risk, as lenders grow pickier on Big Tech bonds. Amazon is barely mentioned; the story bears on it only as one of the Big Tech AI spenders exposed to tighter debt funding.

7.text: Amazon agreed to pay about $7.5 billion for AI startup Decart’s optimization technology and research team to strengthen its Trainium chips. Separately, Amazon signed a long-term Generac supply deal, backs over 5 gigawatts of new nuclear by 2039, and Blue Owl raised $513 million to finance an Amazon data center.

22.text: Amazon short interest rose 7.25% to 101.20 million shares, while ETFs were net buyers of $473.6 million and $34.7 million on two days but net sellers of $102.5 million and $89.6 million on others. Analysts rate Amazon a Hold with a $310 target, and articles note its P/B of 4.4 and options premiums.

8.text: Anthropic held a record IPO, pricing at $83 per share, raising up to $119.5 billion, and jumping 16% in its Nasdaq debut at roughly a $1.2–2 trillion valuation. Amazon is a major Anthropic shareholder and among the biggest beneficiaries.

5.text: AWS grew 39% to $45.98B with record 13.9% operating margins and a $578B backlog, but Amazon's $215B capex drove trailing free cash flow to negative $42.4B, pressuring the stock. Analysts debate whether AI spending pays off.

13.text: SpaceX caught a Starship upper stage, gained FCC approval for orbital data-center satellites, and saw Starlink margins rise, while Rocket Lab hit 100 Electron launches and AST SpaceMobile plunged. Amazon appears only as a doubter of SpaceX's million-satellite plan.

23.text: The Trump administration plans to name Amazon among over two dozen AI "national champions," per a Wall Street Journal report. Separately, it is advancing restrictions on Chinese data center equipment, boosting US optical stocks like Coherent and Lumentum.
